'''Icefiends''' are elemental monsters made entirely out of ice, which can be located in [[Ghorrock]] fortress during and after the completion of [[The Temple at Senntisten]]. They are notable for being significantly stronger than their [[Ice Mountain]] counterparts. Additionally, they are aggressive monsters, whereas their counterparts are not. They are also completely immune to water spells.

During the quest, they appear when a [[Waterfiend (Ghorrock)|waterfiend]] is unfrozen from a block of ice by a [[heat globe]] being placed nearby, and then subsequently removed. They will become waterfiends once again if the heat globe is placed back.

After the quest, they can be found on the dungeon's upper floor.
